Client Intake.name: client-intake
Client Intake.purpose: Supply a specific denial reason for denied IA or TA authorizations after Salesforce establishes the denial. Denial events remain supporting-only; other direct client-specific Slack updates may inform the primary SLA story.

comprehensive.description: Run the full operational sweep for every Opportunity, including Slack. Gmail and linked files remain escalation-only.

standard.description: Run the full operational sweep, including Slack; use Gmail and linked files only for unresolved material gaps.

escalation.description: Run the full operational sweep and search Gmail and linked files for unresolved material gaps.

noteModes.live: Use dated substantive SLA, intake, authorization, and on-hold notes.
noteModes.historical-replay: Use only note state demonstrably available by the point-in-time cutoff.
noteModes.backtest-independent: Hold current SLA notes out so generated findings can be compared independently with human notes.

sources: Salesforce intake prerequisite statuses and timestamps
